name: phone-input
title: Phone Input
description: A phone number field with a searchable country picker and flags that formats as you type and emits E.164, defaulting to the browser's region.
docs: Import: `import { PhoneInput } from '@/components/ui/phone-input'`. The value is E.164 (`+12025550143`) or an empty string; `normalizePhoneNumber`, `formatPhoneNumber`, and `CountryFlag` share the same metadata.
